principle: Body=observer-hosts and communication paths used for in-transit computation. Mind=source-grounded procedural computation, synthetic training and verified navigation. Biological connectome is optional topology data, never an intended organism simulator.

opportunities.description: Train models of computation, serialization, queueing, latency and reliability for eligible observer-host pathways using synthetic telemetry initially; replace with measured E-CPU receipts later.
opportunities.data: source-pinned synthetic query Ground and generated transport-state contexts
opportunities.target: predict route cost under fluctuating communication conditions
opportunities.candidate: identified exact rational path-cost estimator; later learned contextual classifier
opportunities.promotion: receiver-owned source and independently verified synthetic telemetry

opportunities.description: Construct neural operator Grounds from synthetic, task-labeled datasets using existing PNF/SNC compilers; retain semantics, source identity and verification separately.
opportunities.data: synthetic tasks derived from a pinned heterogeneous graph, plus typed operator expressions
opportunities.target: verified task-dependent computation and transfer predictions
opportunities.candidate: PNF widening, SNC exact compiler, or source-pinned sparse model with typed certificates
opportunities.promotion: model identity not inferred from logical parameter count

opportunities.description: Execute selected synthetic neural operators through existing E-CPU Transit/mTLS, under receiver-local admission, with independent output verification; refuse simulated routes as evidence.
opportunities.data: versioned model Ground, receiver capabilities, authenticated TCP/TLS events
opportunities.target: qualified remote computation over actual observer-host paths
opportunities.candidate: E-CPU Transit, ReliableChannel, Hypervisor, TCR-002 tensor-cut worker
opportunities.promotion: must supply native E-CPU execution evidence

opportunities.description: Learn to choose query-relative subspaces, operator demands and host placements using evidence-aware costs while retaining exact Ground verification.
opportunities.data: held-out query families, cost observations and source Ground identity
opportunities.target: correct task result with lower measured total cost
opportunities.candidate: VGI typed navigation, IFS RCN routing, evidence path resolver
opportunities.promotion: learned selection is only a proposal until checked

opportunities.description: Keep model state and structural memory continuous across host departure, route change and replacement, without double-applying effects.
opportunities.data: durable M3 high-water, M1 objects, route epochs, lost-peer faults
opportunities.candidate: existing E-CPU recovery lineage, quorum, computation DAG and transit directory
opportunities.promotion: requires actual crash/rehome evidence not synthetic labels

opportunities.description: Test whether procedural generation yields genuinely different information-bearing functions rather than just new parameter addresses; scale learned or source-verified diversity, not labels.
opportunities.data: distinct verified expert tensors, task semantics, withheld synthetic tasks
opportunities.target: measurable capability per byte and realized operation
opportunities.candidate: VP-005 navigable experts, MWS/HFG source snapshots, VGI equivalence
opportunities.promotion: count semantic distinctions and independent evidence, not only logical experts
